_meta.purpose: Structured version of zao-fractal-timeline.md and fractal-movement-timeline.md for scripts/agents to query without parsing prose.

fields.date: ISO date, or ISO month/year when only that precision is known
fields.title: short label
fields.source: file path or doc reference this was measured/read from
fields.verified: true if independently confirmed by this document's author, false if only the citing source's own claim, unknown if genuinely unresolved

_meta.read_first: ~/zao-vault/projects/fractal-sources-of-truth-audit-2026-09-15.md for why fractal docs disagree across the estate; docs/history/README.md in this repo for orientation.

events.title: BitShares launches
events.detail: Daniel Larimer's first decentralized exchange.

events.title: Steem/Hive launches
events.detail: First blockchain social media with token rewards.

events.title: EOS launches
events.detail: $4B+ market cap at launch.

events.title: "More Equal Animals" published
events.detail: Larimer's book laying out fractal democracy theory.

events.title: Eden on EOS launches
events.detail: First practical fractal-democracy implementation, 400+ peak members.

events.title: First on-chain fractal election
events.detail: Held on Eden on EOS, 13:00 UTC.

events.title: Fractally protocol announced
events.detail: Medium post by Larimer.

events.title: Genesis Fractal
events.detail: 30-week experiment, ~130 participants; proves the weekly Respect Game cadence works.

events.title: Eden Fractal founded
events.detail: Epoch 1, on EOS. Dan SingJoy founder, ~10 weekly regulars.

events.title: Fractalgram released
events.detail: Tadas Vaitiekunas (sim31), Telegram client for live sessions.

events.title: Optimism Fractal launches
events.detail: OP Mainnet, Dan SingJoy + Optimystics, ~65 Respect holders, bi-weekly.

events.title: Zaal joins Optimism Fractal
events.detail: Week 6. Later an active member and council member of Eden Fractal - the on-ramp to founding ZAO Fractal.

events.title: ZAO OG Respect deployed
events.detail: ERC-20, soulbound, Optimism, 0x34cE89baA7E4a4B00E17F7E4C0cb97105C216957. Also Zaal's own earliest OG Respect receipt on record.

events.title: ZAO Fractal begins
events.detail: Weekly, Mondays 6pm EST, Zaal founder.

events.title: ORDAO approved by Optimism Fractal Council
events.detail: Season 5. First production ORDAO deployment on Ethereum mainnet.

events.title: Eden Fractal Epoch 2 launches on Base
events.detail: Event #121, 3-year anniversary. ORDAO deployed; EOS Respect migrated via snapshot + claim.

events.title: ZAO ZOR Respect deployed
events.detail: ERC-1155, soulbound, Optimism, 0x9885CCeEf7E8371Bf8d6f2413723D25917E7445c.

events.title: First ZOR award minted (fractal period 67)
events.detail: The real OG/ZOR dividing line. Corrected 2026-09-02 from an earlier claim of period 73/74.

events.title: OG Respect ledger paused
events.detail: Administrative policy choice, 122 holders / 38,484 supply. Remains mintable if chosen again - "paused by policy," not frozen (language corrected 2026-09-21, PR #31).

events.title: Optimism Fractal pauses indefinitely
events.detail: Council votes to consolidate into Eden Fractal (Base). ZAO Fractal becomes the only active fractal on Optimism Mainnet and one of two on the whole Superchain.

events.title: Bot rebranded fractalbotmarch2026
events.detail: v1.3-v1.6, 52 slash commands, timer overhaul. Archived 2026-03-28 - superseded by fractalbotapril2026.

events.title: Bot v2.0: JSON to Supabase
events.detail: Migrates all storage to Supabase, the same fractal_sessions/fractal_scores/respect_members tables zao-fractal-bot now writes to.

events.title: Bot v2.1
events.detail: Optional onchain auto-submit via hot wallet, Farcaster identity linking, Snapshot cog polling every 5 min.

events.title: ZAOstock sprint-fractal designed
events.detail: Doc 498: three parallel 6-person fractals, bi-weekly, tied to festival milestones. Precedent for the 2026-09-22 multi-tenant ruling.

events.title: ZAO current-state audit (Doc 703)
events.detail: Week 100+, OREC at 242+ transactions, bot v2.1 live. Single-relayer bottleneck and dashboard rebuild flagged.

events.title: Whitepaper ch08 drafted (v0.1)
events.detail: ZAOfractal's own chapter on ZAO Fractal, later corrected 2026-09-02.

events.title: zao-fractal-bot repo starts
events.detail: Ground-up TypeScript rebuild (discord.js, viem, Supabase, Vitest), grounded in ZAOOS research docs 981/982. First commit 4b5cc22.

events.title: fractalbotapril2026 archived (last push)
events.detail: The Python-bot lineage's final state before replacement; a local clone of it was separately named "fractalbotjuly2026" on disk, which earlier audits mistook for a distinct repo.
events.source: gh repo list bettercallzaal (2026-09-25); git remote -v inside ~/Desktop/repos/fractalbotjuly2026

events.title: Onchain award ledger reaches period 111
events.detail: Measured directly from chain for the 2026-09-02 accuracy pass. Distinct from the bot's own session-recording database, which had separate long gaps.

events.title: Subsystem 1 / Subsystem 2 architecture ruling
events.detail: Zaal, binding: v1 (Python) stays down permanently, v2 takes the live game, Hats/proposals/events return later as separated v2 subsystems.

events.title: Whitepaper ch08 accuracy pass
events.detail: Multiple corrections against live chain/Supabase/Airtable: OG/ZOR split moved from 73/74 to 66/67; "40 active per session" corrected to measured median 7 / mean 8 / max 17 across 42 periods; a Fibonacci-scaling arithmetic error fixed; unbroken-streak claim marked unverified.

events.title: v2 build sprint begins (async participation)
events.detail: PRs #23-28. Found the /start-can-never-record-a-fractal bug (discord_roster.confidence rejected 'manual'), fixed in migration 0006.

events.title: 36-decision Season 3 brainstorm captured
events.detail: Zaal dictates the membership redesign, one question at a time, verbatim.

events.title: PR #29 and #30 merged
events.detail: #29: vote-weight-snapshot claim corrected (OREC reads live, not at proposal creation). #30: bot made deployable/observable plus four security fixes.

events.title: season3 lane opens; ZIP-2 drafted; sources-of-truth audit run
events.detail: Finds a live third repo (ZAOfractal), a dormant fourth (zaofractal-contracts) with an unseen IRespect implementation, a manifesto already published live contradicting "needs writing," and a fractal.thezao.com domain collision.

events.title: ZIP-2 merges to zao-papers main
events.detail: Accepted status, per that repo's merge-is-ratification convention.

events.title: PR #31 merged; README and whitepaper both updated
events.detail: OG Respect language corrected to "paused by policy." Both this repo's README and ZAOfractal's ch08 declare Subsystem 1 "live in production" the same day - self-description, RESOLVED FALSE 2026-09-25 (see next event).
events.source: this repo's PR #31; ZAOfractal whitepaper ch08

events.title: Grill-seat governance rulings begin
events.detail: Front door = instant ZID on sign-in; governance narrowed to come only from ZAO fractal participation.

events.title: Multi-tenant fractal model ruled
events.detail: ZAO Festivals gets its own fractal and ledger; any ZAO-incubated project may run its own fractal under ZAO tooling; ZAO Festivals fractal ordered built immediately for ZAOstock (event 3 October). Airtable (appTUNG04rjZ9kSF4) named primary reconciliation source ahead of the Discord database; full history reconstruction ordered (burned periods 67-70, unminted 71-72, ~21-week blackout from period 93 - the bot's recording gap, not the onchain mint record).

events.title: ZID seniority roster measured
events.detail: Full onchain OG Respect transfer history walked, 518 rows, 123 distinct addresses, 117 named from Zaal's Airtable. Oldest receipt: Zaal, 2024-07-30.

events.title: Season 3 launch date floated as tentative
events.detail: Zaal: "maybe" moves 1 November to New Year's, more time to upgrade/test; needs a real governance proposal and promotion push first. Not decided.

events.title: Live-bot claim resolved: the Python bot, not this repo, is running
events.detail: Zaal ran /admin_lookup in the live #fractal-bot Discord channel; the bot responded. /admin_lookup exists only in fractalbotapril2026 cogs/wallet.py (grep of this repo finds nothing). The bot actually answering commands in Discord today runs the archived Python codebase, contradicting the 2026-09-21 "Subsystem 1 live in production" claim in this repo's own README.
events.source: live Discord screenshot 2026-09-25 5:16pm; grep -rl admin_lookup across both repos

events.title: Governance conflict found: whitepaper's proposed balance decay vs Season 3's no-burn design
events.detail: The whitepaper drafts (ch04 section VI, ch05) propose a future 2% weekly decay on Respect balances, to keep governance weighted toward recent contribution. ZIP-2/brainstorm #1 say the opposite for Season 3: the active pool changes, balances never do, nothing burns. Not resolved here - recorded as NEEDS ZAAL in ZAOOS doc 2558 (contradiction item 5, commit bca759360, PR #3658) and in zao-vault/handoffs/status/zao-papers.md by the zao-papers lane, which found it and is raising it with Zaal directly.
events.source: cross-session message from the zao-papers lane ("fractal 1"), 2026-09-26

events.title: Balance-decay vs no-burn conflict resolved: no-burn wins, decay cut from whitepaper
events.detail: Zaal ruled in the zao-papers afternoon grill (ruling 6): activation already does what decay was for, and every system surveyed in ZAOOS doc 2558 (Colony, Gardens, Coordinape, fractally's own moving average) decays weight or a scoring input, never the earned record - keeping both would punish absence twice. The 2% weekly Respect decay comes out of whitepaper/draft/ch04-the-respect-token.md section VI and the matching ch05 paragraph; ZIP-2's no-burn design stands.
events.source: zao-vault/decisions/grill-2026-09-26-zao-papers-afternoon.md, ruling 6, commit 0f9cfad2; relayed cross-session by the zao-papers lane ("fractal 1")

open_contradictions: RESOLVED 2026-09-25 (was open): "Subsystem 1 live in production" - false. The Python bot (fractalbotapril2026) is the one actually answering commands in Discord, confirmed via the admin_lookup command trace.
Unbroken weekly streak - whitepaper ch08 marks this explicitly unverified; gaps exist in the payment record for periods 71, 72, and no evidence either way for 103.
Migrations 0001-0006 confirmed applied (2026-09-19). Migration 0006's manual CHECK constraint specifically, and migration 0007, remain UNKNOWN - not visible via REST.
"40 active per session" (older docs, including this repo's own deploy runbook) vs. measured median 7 / mean 8 / max 17 across 42 recorded periods (whitepaper ch08, 2026-09-02).

fractalbotmarch2026 vs fractalbotapril2026 as the source of "52 slash commands" - both figures appear attached to different repo names across sources; the monthly-rename chain makes this plausible either way but the exact commit was not pinned down here.
If the Python bot is still live, what does this repo's own "Subsystem 1 active in production" README claim actually refer to? Not guessed here - needs whoever controls the bot-hosting.net panel.

RESOLVED 2026-09-26 (was open, NEEDS ZAAL): whitepaper drafts proposed 2% weekly Respect-balance decay; ZIP-2/Season 3 said balances never decay. Zaal ruled no-burn wins (grill ruling 6, zao-vault commit 0f9cfad2) - decay comes out of ch04 section VI and ch05.
